# langfuse_prompt (Resource)

Manage a prompt in a project using project-scoped credentials. Prompt versions are immutable in Langfuse: changing prompt, config, tags, or commit_message, or removing a label, creates a new version and moves the configured labels to it. Adding labels updates the current version in place. Earlier versions are kept until the resource is destroyed, which deletes the prompt with all of its versions. The resource tracks the version it created; versions created outside Terraform are left alone. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:prompt_name (imports the latest version).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_prompt" "summarize" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "support/summarize"
  prompt             = "Summarize the following ticket in three sentences:\n\n{{ticket}}"
  labels             = ["production"]
  tags               = ["support"]
  commit_message     = "Managed by Terraform"
  config = jsonencode({
    model       = "gpt-4o"
    temperature = 0.2
  })
}

resource "langfuse_prompt" "assistant" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "support/assistant"
  type               = "chat"
  labels             = ["production"]
  prompt = jsonencode([
    { role = "system", content = "You are a support assistant for {{product}}." },
    { type = "placeholder", name = "history" },
    { role = "user", content = "{{question}}" },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the prompt, unique within the project. Use slashes to place it in folders. Changing it forces a new prompt.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `prompt` (String) Content of the prompt. For text prompts, the prompt text. For chat prompts, a JSON array string of messages (`{role, content}`) and placeholders (`{type = "placeholder", name}`).

### Optional

- `commit_message` (String) Commit message of the tracked version.
- `config` (String) Arbitrary configuration stored with the prompt version (for example model parameters) as a JSON object string.
- `labels` (Set of String) Labels of the tracked version, for example `production`. A label points to one version at a time. The `latest` label is managed by Langfuse and cannot be set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the prompt. Tags apply to all versions of the prompt.
- `type` (String) Type of the prompt. Valid values: text, chat. Defaults to text. Changing it forces a new prompt.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name of the prompt.
- `version` (Number) Version number tracked by this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_prompt.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${PROMPT_NAME}"
```
